en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large formation of uniformed soldiers standing in ranks on an open parade ground lined with trees and barracks-like buildings. Several officers stand or walk in front of the formation, seemingly inspecting or organizing a guard parade. The scene is calm and formal, and printed German text identifying the place and scene appears at the bottom along with a publisher line and date.
